Find.title: Find
Find.description: Metal detecting ground find logged by a user with GPS location, detector readings, AI valuation, and optional public community sharing.

userId.description: UID of the user who logged the find

title.description: Name or title of the find

targetVdi.description: Target VDI or metal detector ID

customTags.description: List of tags like period, object type

notes.description: Field notes, soil conditions, detector settings

generalLocation.description: County or general region (e.g. Wiltshire, UK) for public privacy

aiAnalysis.description: AI valuation and historical identification details

isPublic.description: Whether shared to the detectorist community feed

nearScheduledMonument.description: Whether find is within 50m of a scheduled monument

nearestMonumentName.description: Name of nearest scheduled monument if applicable

nearestMonumentDistance.description: Distance in meters to nearest monument boundary

/finds/{findId}.description: Collection of metal detecting ground finds
